1: When the Imminent [Hour] befallsThat is, the Day of Resurrection and Judgement.
2: —there is no denying that it will befall—
3: [it will be] lowering, exalting.That is, abasing the faithless and raising the faithful in station.
4: When the earth is shaken violently,
5: and the mountains are shattered into bits
8: The People of the Right Hand—and what are the People of the Right Hand?
9: And the People of the Left Hand—and what are the People of the Left Hand?
10: And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones:Cf. :, :, :, :, :.
11: they are the ones brought near [to Allah],
12: [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss.
13: A multitude from the former [generations]That is, from the communities of the former prophets.
14: and a few from the latter ones.
16: reclining on them, face to face.
17: They will be waited upon by immortal youths,
18: with goblets and ewersand a cup of a clear wine,Or ‘flowing wine.’
19: which neither causes them headachenor stupefaction,
20: and such fruits as they prefer
21: and such flesh of fowls as they desire,
24: a reward for what they used to do.
25: They will not hear thereinany vain talk or sinful speech,
27: And the People of the Right Hand—what are the People of the Right Hand?
29: and clustered spathesThis is according to the reading wa ṭalʿin manḍūd (instead of wa ṭalḥin manḍūd, meaning ‘and clustered plantains’) narrated from Imam ʿAlī and Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (ʿa) and Ibn ʿAbbās. (Muʿjam, al-Kashshāf).
30: and extended shade,Or ‘twilight;’ see the note at :.
35: We have created them with a special creation,
38: for the People of the Right Hand.
40: and a multitude from the latter [ones].
41: And the People of the Left Hand—what are the People of the Left Hand?
42: Amid infernal miasma and boiling water
43: and the shadow of a dense black smoke,
45: Indeed they had been affluent before this,
46: and they used to persist in the great sin.That is, shirk. Cf. :.
47: And they used to say,‘What! When we are dead and become dustand bones,shall we be resurrected?
49: Say, ‘Indeed the former and latter generations
50: will all be gatheredfor the tryst of a known day.
52: will surely eat from the Zaqqūm tree
53: and stuff your bellies with it,
54: and drink boiling water on top of it,
56: Such will be the hospitality they receiveon the Day of Retribution.Or ‘the Day of Judgement.’
57: We created you.Then why do you not acknowledge it?
58: Have you considered the sperm that you emit?
59: Is it you who create it,or are We the creator?
60: We have ordained death among you,and We are not to be outmaneuvered
61: from replacing you with your likesand recreating youin [a realm] you do not know.
62: Certainly you have known the first genesis,then why do you not take admonition?
63: Have you considered what you sow?
64: Is it you who make it grow,or are We the grower?
65: If We wish, We surely turn it into chaff,whereat you are left stunned [saying to yourselves,]Or ‘regretful.’
68: Have you considered the water that you drink?
69: Is it you who bring it down from the rain cloud,or is it We who bring [it] down?
70: If We wish We can make it bitter.Then why do you not give thanks?
71: Have you considered the fire that you kindle?
72: Was it you who caused its tree to grow,or were We the grower?
73: It was We who made it a reminderand a boon for the desert-dwellers.
74: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme.
75: So I swearby the places where the stars set!Or ‘I will not swear.’Or ‘by the times when.’Or ‘by the places where the stars fall.’ Or ‘I swear by the orbits of the stars.’
76: And indeed it is a great oath, should you know.
77: This is indeed a noble Qurʾān,
78: in a guarded Book,That is, the Preserved Tablet.
79: —no one touches it except the pure ones—
80: gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds.
81: What! Do you take lightly this discourse?
82: And make your denial of it your vocation?Or ‘livelihood.’ According to the reading tajʿalūna shukrakum, narrated from Imam ʿAli ibn Abī Ṭālib and Imam al-Ṣādiq in al-Tafsīr al-Qummī under this verse, the translation will be ‘You make your denial of it your thanksgiving.’ That is, instead of being grateful for it, you deny it.
83: So when it reaches the throat [of the dying person]That is, the soul, while leaving the body during the death-throes.
84: and at that moment you are looking on
85: —and We are nearer to him than you are,though you do not perceive—That is, to the dying person.
86: then why do you not, if you are not subjectOr ‘if you are not liable to retribution.’
87: [to the Divine dispensation], restore it,should you be truthful?
88: Then, if he be of those brought near,That is, of ‘the foremost ones’ mentioned in verses -.
89: then ease, abundance, and a garden of bliss.
90: And if he be of the People of the Right Hand,
91: then ‘Peace be on you,’[a greeting] from the People of the Right Hand!
92: But if he be of the impugners,the astray ones,
93: then a treat of boiling water
94: and entry into hell.Or ‘roasting in hell.’
96: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme!
